hero.title: UNLOCK: Create Beyond Boundaries
hero.subtitle: The AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge

about.summary: UNLOCK is an AI workplace innovation challenge and grand expo hosted at UiTM Shah Alam. Seven teams (five University Student teams and two Young Professional teams) join an online incubation with 2 workshops. All 7 teams then present their innovation live on the Main Stage at UNLOCK Summit Day on 6 December 2026 at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam, where every visitor can explore interactive booths from our collaborators, partners and sponsors with the UNLOCK Passport.
about.vision: To become a leading platform that bridges academia and industry in nurturing an innovative, AI-ready generation capable of shaping a sustainable, ethical and future-driven workforce.
about.mission: To empower students and young professionals with AI knowledge, innovative thinking, and practical problem-solving skills while fostering meaningful collaboration between academia and industry to promote ethical and responsible AI adoption in the workplace.
about.objective: To enhance knowledge and understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in the workplace, encourage the development of innovative ideas and practical AI-driven solutions, and strengthen strategic collaboration among universities, industries, and communities towards ethical, responsible, and sustainable AI adoption.

askOnly.q: What is UNLOCK?
askOnly.kw: unlock about event summit challenge apa
askOnly.a: UNLOCK is an AI workplace innovation challenge and grand expo hosted at UiTM Shah Alam. Seven teams build AI prototypes in 2 online workshops, and all 7 present them live at UNLOCK Summit Day on 6 December 2026 at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam, alongside interactive booths from our collaborators, partners and sponsors.
askOnly.alt: It is the AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge: an online incubation with 2 workshops for 7 teams, followed by Summit Day at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam, where every team presents its AI prototype and visitors collect UNLOCK Passport stamps at partner booths.

askOnly.q: Who organises UNLOCK?
askOnly.kw: organiser organizer committee penganjur
askOnly.a: UNLOCK is run by the UNLOCK committee, with OCM, CMP Associate and UiTM Shah Alam (the host) as partners and HackDev as collaborator.
askOnly.alt: The UNLOCK committee organises it, with OCM, CMP Associate and UiTM Shah Alam as partners and HackDev as collaborator.

askOnly.q: When does registration close?
askOnly.kw: deadline closing last date tutup closes
askOnly.a: Pre-registration has been extended. It now closes on Thursday 19 November 2026 at 11:59 p.m., or earlier if all 5 team places in a category are filled.
askOnly.alt: You have until 19 November 2026, 11:59 p.m., but each category has only 5 team places, so the form closes as soon as they are taken. Check the live team spots on this page.

askOnly.q: Is the event online or physical?
askOnly.kw: online physical hybrid venue location held
askOnly.a: Both. The 2 workshops are online on Google Meet, and Summit Day on 6 December 2026 is in person at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.
askOnly.alt: The workshops are online on Google Meet (Workshop 1 is a full day on 22 November, Workshop 2 is on 28 November). Summit Day is physical at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

askOnly.q: How much is the registration fee?
askOnly.kw: fee yuran cost price free percuma bayar payment pay
askOnly.a: The registration fee is RM65 per team for the Student category and RM180 per team for the Young Professional category. For now it is a pre-registration, so you pay later: we email the payment details after you pre-register.
askOnly.alt: It is RM65 per team for students and RM180 per team for young professionals. You do not pay at pre-registration; we email the payment details afterwards.

askOnly.q: Do I need AI or coding experience?
askOnly.kw: experience beginner coding skill programming pengalaman knowledge
askOnly.a: Workshop 1 is a full, guided day: HackDev teaches Applied AI Literacy and takes you step by step through planning, building and shipping your prototype with AI tools. Workshop 2 adds feedback from real industry. If you are unsure about your team's skills, ask us.
askOnly.alt: The workshops are guided: HackDev helps you plan, build and ship your prototype in Workshop 1, and industry gives feedback in Workshop 2. For specific concerns about skills, contact the committee.

askOnly.q: What will we build?
askOnly.kw: build project prototype create product idea innovation
askOnly.a: A working AI prototype or proof of concept that solves a realistic workplace problem in the track assigned to your team, with clear user workflows and measurable business impact.
askOnly.alt: Each team designs and builds an AI-powered solution for a real organisational challenge, showing the problem, the AI architecture, the user flows and the expected impact.

askOnly.q: Can students and professionals be in the same team?
askOnly.kw: mixed same team combine both category
askOnly.a: Each team registers under one category: Student for university students, or Young Professional for early-career working adults. If your team is mixed, please ask the committee before registering.
askOnly.alt: Teams are registered as either Student or Young Professional. For a mixed team, contact us so we can advise you.

askOnly.q: What if my team has fewer than 5 members?
askOnly.kw: fewer less four members incomplete exactly short
askOnly.a: Every team must have exactly 5 members. If you are still looking for members, ask the committee how we can help.
askOnly.alt: The rule is strictly 5 members per team, so please complete your team before registering. Contact us if you need advice.

askOnly.q: Are there still finalists?
askOnly.kw: finalist finalists selection select top 2 top 3 top 4 how many evaluate chosen winner
askOnly.a: No. There is no finalist selection anymore: all 7 teams present on stage at Summit Day, and the judges choose the Top 3 teams, who receive rewards. Every other team receives goodies.
askOnly.alt: Every team goes to Summit Day. The judges pick the Top 3 teams from the stage presentations.

askOnly.q: Do all teams join the summit?
askOnly.kw: all teams attend finale everyone
askOnly.a: Yes. All 7 teams present their innovation on the Main Stage at Summit Day. Everyone who attends can also collect UNLOCK Passport stamps at the interactive booths of our collaborators, partners and sponsors.
askOnly.alt: Yes, every team presents on stage at Summit Day. Visitors can also explore the collaborator, partner and sponsor booths with the UNLOCK Passport.

askOnly.q: What do we need to prepare for the summit?

news.title: All 7 teams on stage at Summit Day
news.body: There are no finalists this year: all 7 teams will present their innovation on the Main Stage at Summit Day on 6 December, 8 minutes per team. Every team submits its prototype slides by Wednesday 2 December. The Top 3 teams receive rewards, and every other team receives goodies.

news.title: Updated submission dates
news.body: There is no submission on 24 November, and teams no longer need to send questions by 26 November. Prototype slides, based on your innovation, are due by Wednesday 2 December 2026.

news.title: 7 tracks, drawn randomly at Workshop 1
news.body: UNLOCK now has 7 tracks: Finance & Accounting and Logistics & Supply Chain join the original 5. Each team gets one track by random draw, revealed live at Workshop 1 on Sunday 22 November. Ask UNLOCK about any track to see example ideas.

news.title: Welcome, YTL AI Labs and Ombak Exclusive!
news.body: YTL AI Labs, the team behind Malaysia's ILMU AI models, and Ombak Exclusive join UNLOCK as confirmed sponsors.

news.title: Pre-registration extended to 19 November
news.body: Pre-registration now closes on Thursday 19 November 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Each category still has only 5 team places, so register early. Workshop 1 is on Sunday 22 November (9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Google Meet).

news.title: New workshop dates: 2 workshops only
news.body: We have combined the first two workshops. Workshop 1 is now a full-day workshop on Sunday 22 November 2026 (9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Google Meet), and Workshop 2 (industry Q&A and feedback) is on Saturday 28 November. We sincerely apologise for the earlier delays. Payment will be made through a new Google Form: RM65 per Student team and RM180 per Young Professional team.

news.title: Tracks, workshop date and payment
news.body: Tracks are now assigned to each team by the committee, so the track chosen in the registration form is no longer final. The Workshop 1 date will be announced soon. Payment will be made through a new Google Form that we will send to you: RM65 per Student team and RM180 per Young Professional team. Please do not pay before you receive it.

news.title: Pre-registration extended to 18 November
news.body: Pre-registration now closes on Wednesday 18 November 2026. Workshop 1 (Kickoff) is no longer on 15 November; its new date will be announced soon. Pay later: payment details are sent after you pre-register.

news.title: Welcome, Bean & Green!
news.body: Bean & Green joins UNLOCK as a confirmed sponsor.

news.title: Summit Day at Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam
news.body: Stage presentations by all 7 teams, awards for the Top 3, and the UNLOCK Passport: collect stamps at interactive booths from our collaborators, partners and sponsors.
